content: Imanuypanuysi Diosta cäsucuyäshun paywan cawananchipag
Chauragar cäsucurcay “Chay ali cawacuyman yaycapäcunquim” Dios niyämashaga. Chaura maygaysi guepa carärinquimantag.
Noganchitas unay awillunchicunata ali willapata musyachingannuymi musyarayächimanchi. Chayta mayacurarcayarsi paycunaga manam cäsucucarachu. Chaura chay mayacurcangan manam välishachu.
Nätan Diosman yupachicunganchipam, chay ali cawaymanga nä yaycurayanchi. Chaura mana yupachicugcunapagmi isquirbishachrüga Dios cay niyan:

content.text: “Nogaga piñasha cayar juracururä chay ali cawacuyman manam

content: Chaura chay mana cäsucugcunaga manam imaysi aliga capäcungachu, galayunanchru ima-aygatas camarcur Dios alisca cushisha cananpagnuyga.
Chaynuymi isquirbishachrüsi ganchris junagpitaga cay niyan: “Diosga ima-aygatas rurayta ushacurcur ganchris junagchrüga cushisham cara” niyanmi.
Nätan yapaysi isquirbishachrüga cay niyantan:

content.text: “Chay mana cäsucugcunaga manam imaysi yaycapäcungachu chay ali cawacuymanga” niyantan.

content: Chaura waquinsi yaycapäcunmanran chay ali cawaymanga. Nätan naupata chay ali willapa mayacugcunaga mana yaycapäcushachu, mana chayta cäsucurcarmi.
Chaura Diosga
Chaypitaga mas guepatas David isquirbira cay nirmi:

content.text: “Dios nircayäshungayta canan mayarcayarga, ama rumi shongo capäcuychu” nirmi.

content: Nätan Josué chay ali cawacuyman Israel castanchicunata razonpa yaycachisha captinga, manachr Diosga ninmanchu cara: “Mas guepamanga chay ali cawacuyman yaycapäcungam” nirga.
Chaura chaynuy nirayaptinga ali cawayman yaycapäcunmanran Diospa runancunaga.
Chaura Dios ningannuy ali cawayman yaycugcunaga cushisham capäcunga. Dioschu ima-aygata galayunanchru rurayta ushacurcurga cushisha cara chaynuymi.
Chauragar imanaypa ayganaypas chay ali cawayman yaycuyta munapäcuy, nätan ama chay unay awillunchicunanuy mana cäsucugga capäcuychu.

Chaura Diosninchipita willapaga yachrachimanchi imaycamas Dioswan cawananchipitam. Chay willapaga cayan caynuymi: Juc runachu juc espäda ishcay lädüpa cuchucunayogwan ruyi ruyicama tucsirunman. Chaypitas mas ruyi ruyicamam yaycun juc runaman Diospa chay ali willapanga. Chaura chay willapam tantiachimanchi ali rurayta u lutan rurayta munayanganchitas.
Dios camangancunaga ima-aygas cayan ricashalam paypitaga. Chaymi ali u lutan ruranganchitas quiquinchi nishun.
Jesusga cayan lapan sacerdöticunapita mas alinnincagmi
Chaura Diospa-mayin Jesusga cayan sacerdöticunapa mas mandagnincagpitas mas munayniyogmi. Payga jana pachamanmi yaycurayan. Chauragar payman yupachicuyälar cawayäshun.

Sacerdöticunapa mas mandagnin Jesusninchiga manam rircaramanchichu ima juchaman yaycuyashas, antis payga juchäcachiy munasha casha cuyapälarmi yanapämanchi quiquinsi juchäcachiy munasha car. Nätan payga noganchinuy juchäcachiy munasha cayarsi manam juchäcurachüga.
Chauragar cuyapäcug Dioscagman ashuyushun cuyapämänanchipag, jinaman payman yupachicuyälar cacuyäshun ima-ayga captinsi cuyapämarlanchi yanapämänanchipag.
